pages.text: The $(item)woodsman's post$(): made with an axe. Fence in dirt.

pages.title: Trees
pages.text: It plants saplings from the stock on every other square, like a chessboard, so each tree has room. It fells a grown tree whole, leaves and all, and plants again.$(br2)Cactus on sand, bamboo and sweet berries grow here too. A cactus in flower is cut for the flower.
